general_claim_language_rules: RULE 1: Use 'survives [specific test]' not 'survives' alone. Always state what was tested.
RULE 2: Use 'partially validated' not 'validated' when engineering is moderate (50-70% accuracy).
RULE 3: Use 'SEARCH_INCOMPLETE' not 'NOT_FOUND' when any source is unavailable.
RULE 4: Never claim 'global novelty' from a single source or single test. Use 'NOT_FOUND_AFTER_[specific source]_SEARCH'.
RULE 5: Never claim 'works in humans' without in-vivo data. Use 'MODEL_DERIVED' or 'HYPOTHESIS'.
RULE 6: Defeating one alternative does NOT establish superiority. State 'survives [alternative] challenge' not 'is superior'.
RULE 7: Always separate ENGINEERING_STATUS from PATENT_STATUS. Engineering ceiling ≠ patent ceiling.
RULE 8: '20 strengthening papers' is not '20 reasons to believe'. Strengthening literature matters only after destructive interpretations are exhausted.
RULE 9: Do not manufacture better numbers by changing the model. Pre-register thresholds BEFORE simulation.
RULE 10: Do not create 'Position Xb' unless alternative solves the SAME coupled problem.
